commits.message: chore: publish 0.2.0 in the market index

0.3.0: session-keyed PTY terminals with asynchronous jobs

Replace the profile-shared pipe shell with one real PTY per DSH session id: tools address a terminal by session id, so an agent can attach to the shell another session left behind, with cwd, variables and background processes intact.

Commands are framed by writing a script file and sourcing it with stdin from /dev/null, then detected by a sentinel whose token lives only in the environment, so terminal echo cannot fake completion. bash_exec returns a job id immediately; bash_wait, bash_read and bash_interrupt operate on it.

Tool schemas now follow the harness authoring style (flat parameter map with inline required:true) and are validated against dsh-tools' own compiler in test/schema.test.mjs.
index: publish 0.3.0 in the market index

fix: use raw JSON Schema for output.schema, authoring spec for parameters

ToolRuntime.register() asserts output.schema directly, so inline required:true inside properties is rejected there, while parameters must use the flat authoring spec. Split the two and validate both against dsh-tools in test/schema.test.mjs.
index: pin 0.3.0 to the release commit

replies.body: Thanks for submitting StartLux Decision! I checked `dsh-startlux-decision@0.1.2`, including its public source, MIT license, archive integrity, bundle patch and entry files, and added it to the listing configuration. The description keeps the API Key requirement, external context sharing, disabled/shadow defaults and fail-open behavior. It will appear once the update is pushed and GitHub Actions publishes it. 🙂
感谢提交！已核查 `dsh-kimi-assemble@1.1.1` 的公开源码、MIT 许可证、归档哈希、补丁和入口，已加入收录配置。介绍保留了 Kimi 浏览器扩展/WebBridge、Windows KimiCU 需另行安装，以及操作真实浏览器和桌面窗口的前提。提交推送且 GitHub Actions 发布完成后即可看到。🙂

本轮已复核全部 6 个 Git 更新和 CodeBuddy 异常：

- `dsh-shared-bash`：0.2.0 → 0.3.0，归档与入口检查通过，已更新固定提交和 SHA-512，并补充 PTY 子进程服务要求。
- `@yyyzl/dsh-image-feedback`：0.1.0 → 0.2.0，归档与入口检查通过，已更新固定提交和 SHA-512。
- Workbench 0.1.2、主题 0.2.2、Extensions 0.1.1、Persona 0.1.1：以上版本均带 `-dsh.0.2.1-rc.2` 后缀。其固定 Git 归档缺少清单 `./client` 引用的 `lib/client.js`，本轮保留原有固定版本。请把预构建客户端提交到可安装的 Git 根目录，或发布包含完整构建产物的 npm 包，再提供版本/完整 SHA 供复核。GitHub Release 附件里的 tgz 与源码归档不同，当前 Git 收录方式不能直接改用该附件。
- `@tnnevol/dsh-codebuddy@0.2.1-rc.2.17`：Apache-2.0 许可证存在，实际缺少的是公开源码仓库信息；进一步确认上游已停止维护、下架插件并撤下公开源码，因此从本次收录配置移除，避免继续推荐。上游说明：https://github.com/FNOSP/fnos-dsh/blob/b1b88ff8fae813c0fa67e4f5e3a1f539e18b2c4e/docs/requirements/FNOS-025-codebuddy-plugin-delisting.md

以上为发布配置变更，全量检查和发布交给 GitHub Actions；该维护单需保留，等待其余 4 个 Git 归档补齐。
